description: Build the complete backend: schema, all domain packages (filer, recipient, filing, cart, order, w9, download, user, role, wallet), and CORS config. This is the foundation all other FEATs depend on.
steps:
Step 1 — Replace schema.sql entirely. Write the following tables to D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend\src\main\resources\schema.sql (keep the existing 'test' table as-is at the bottom so the Test package continues to compile):
  - filer: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, ein CHAR(9) NOT NULL UNIQUE, address VARCHAR(255), address2 VARCHAR(255), city VARCHAR(100), state CHAR(2), zip VARCHAR(10), email VARCHAR(255), phone VARCHAR(20), state_id VARCHAR(50), name2 VARCHAR(255), mask BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, forms_used TEXT, pending_count INT DEFAULT 0, ready_count INT DEFAULT 0, filed_count INT DEFAULT 0, w9_total INT DEFAULT 0, w9_required INT DEFAULT 0, w9_received INT DEFAULT 0, warning TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
  - recipient: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, filer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES filer(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, type VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, tin VARCHAR(11) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, address VARCHAR(255), city VARCHAR(100), state VARCHAR(50), zip VARCHAR(10), email VARCHAR(255), econsent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, w9_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Not requested', w9_sent_at DATE, w9_got_at DATE, w9_reminders INT DEFAULT 0
  - filing: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, filer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES filer(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, recipient_id BIGINT REFERENCES recipient(id), tax_year INT NOT NULL, form VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, recipient_name VARCHAR(255), tin VARCHAR(11), amount NUMERIC(14,2), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending', issue TEXT, order_id VARCHAR(20), edited_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
  - cart_item: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, filing_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES filing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id BIGINT, added_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
  - taxseer_order: id VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY, filer_id BIGINT REFERENCES filer(id), filer_name VARCHAR(255), form_summary VARCHAR(255), placed_date VARCHAR(50), tax_year INT, total_forms INT, amount NUMERIC(10,2), status VARCHAR(20), rejected_forms INT DEFAULT 0, accepted_forms INT DEFAULT 0, recipient_copies TEXT, downloadable BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, submission_id VARCHAR(100), submitted_at VARCHAR(50), recipients INT DEFAULT 0, accepted_recipients INT DEFAULT 0, rejected_recipients INT DEFAULT 0, notes TEXT
  - w9_request: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, recipient_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipient(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, filer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES filer(id), sent_at DATE, got_at DATE, reminders INT DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Requested'
  - download: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, filer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES filer(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, by_user VARCHAR(255), download_date VARCHAR(50), download_type VARCHAR(255), forms_count INT DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Ready'
  - app_user: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, first_name VARCHAR(100), last_name VARCHAR(100), email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, phone VARCHAR(20), role VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'preparer', filers TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Invited', last_login VARCHAR(100), two_step BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE
  - app_role: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, key VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name VARCHAR(100), description TEXT, locked BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, permissions TEXT
  - wallet: id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT REFERENCES app_user(id), balance NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
  Keep at the end: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test (...) unchanged.

Step 2 — Create com.taxseer.config.CorsConfig in D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend\src\main\java\com\taxseer\config\CorsConfig.java. Define a @Bean CorsWebFilter that allows origin http://localhost:4200 with all headers and methods. This must be in place before controllers are called.

Step 3 — Create the 'filer' domain package: D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend\src\main\java\com\taxseer\filer\. Create:
  - Filer.java: @Table('filer') entity with all columns from schema step 1. Use Long id (@Id), String name, String ein, String address, String address2, String city, String state, String zip, String email, String phone, String stateId, String name2, Boolean mask, String formsUsed (comma-separated in DB), Integer pendingCount, Integer readyCount, Integer filedCount, Integer w9Total, Integer w9Required, Integer w9Received, String warning. Lombok @Getter @Setter @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Builder.
  - FilerRepository.java: extends R2dbcRepository<Filer, Long>. Add: Flux<Filer> findByNameContainingIgnoreCaseOrEinContaining(String name, String ein); for search.
  - FilerService.java: @Service. Inject FilerRepository. Methods: Flux<Filer> findAll(), Flux<Filer> search(String q), Mono<Filer> findById(Long id), Mono<Filer> save(Filer filer), Mono<Void> delete(Long id).
  - FilerController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/filers'). GET / → findAll(). GET /?q={query} → search(q) using @RequestParam(required=false). GET /{id} → findById. POST / → save. PUT /{id} → update. DELETE /{id} → delete.

  - Recipient.java: @Table('recipient') entity: Long id, Long filerId, String type, String tin, String name, String address, String city, String state, String zip, String email, Boolean econsent, String w9Status, LocalDate w9SentAt, LocalDate w9GotAt, Integer w9Reminders.
  - RecipientRepository.java: extends R2dbcRepository<Recipient, Long>. Add: Flux<Recipient> findByFilerId(Long filerId); Flux<Recipient> findByFilerIdAndNameContainingIgnoreCase(Long filerId, String name);
  - RecipientService.java: @Service. Methods: Flux<Recipient> findByFiler(Long filerId), Flux<Recipient> search(Long filerId, String q), Mono<Recipient> findById(Long id), Mono<Recipient> save(Recipient r), Mono<Void> delete(Long id).
  - RecipientController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/recipients'). GET /?filerId={id} → findByFiler. GET /?filerId={id}&q={query} → search. GET /{id}. POST /. PUT /{id}. DELETE /{id}.

  - Filing.java: @Table('filing') entity: Long id, Long filerId, Long recipientId, Integer taxYear, String form, String recipientName, String tin, BigDecimal amount, String status, String issue, String orderId, LocalDateTime editedAt, LocalDateTime createdAt.
  - FilingRepository.java: extends R2dbcRepository<Filing, Long>. Add: Flux<Filing> findByFilerId(Long filerId); Flux<Filing> findByFilerIdAndTaxYear(Long filerId, Integer taxYear); Flux<Filing> findByFilerIdAndStatus(Long filerId, String status);
  - FilingService.java: @Service. Inject FilingRepository. Methods: Flux<Filing> findByFiler(Long filerId, Integer taxYear, String status), Mono<Filing> findById(Long id), Mono<Filing> save(Filing f), Mono<Filing> updateStatus(Long id, String status), Mono<Void> delete(Long id).
  - FilingController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/filings'). GET /?filerId={id}&taxYear={year}&status={s} (all optional query params). GET /{id}. POST /. PUT /{id}. DELETE /{id}. PATCH /{id}/status with body {status}.

Step 6 — Create the 'cart' domain package: D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend\src\main\java\com\taxseer\cart\. Create:
  - CartItem.java: @Table('cart_item'): Long id, Long filingId, Long userId, LocalDateTime addedAt.
  - CartRepository.java: extends R2dbcRepository<CartItem, Long>. Add: Flux<CartItem> findByUserId(Long userId); Mono<Void> deleteByFilingId(Long filingId);

Step 7 — Create the 'order' domain package: D:\Rasool\Project\TAXSEER\Taxseer-Backend\src\main\java\com\taxseer\order\. Create:
  - TaxseerOrder.java: @Table('taxseer_order'): String id (@Id), Long filerId, String filerName, String formSummary, String placedDate, Integer taxYear, Integer totalForms, BigDecimal amount, String status, Integer rejectedForms, Integer acceptedForms, String recipientCopies, Boolean downloadable, String submissionId, String submittedAt, Integer recipients, Integer acceptedRecipients, Integer rejectedRecipients, String notes.
  - OrderRepository.java: extends R2dbcRepository<TaxseerOrder, String>. Add: Flux<TaxseerOrder> findByFilerIdAndStatus(Long filerId, String status); Flux<TaxseerOrder> findByFilerNameContainingIgnoreCase(String name); Flux<TaxseerOrder> findByStatus(String status);
  - OrderService.java: @Service. findAll(String status, String q, Long filerId), findById(String id), save(TaxseerOrder o).
  - OrderController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/orders'). GET / with optional query params status, q, filerId. GET /{id}. POST /.
